decision.chose: export post_prompt(entry, url) from Dictate.js itself and import it into compose.js
decision.why: Dictate.js already owned the exact fetch-timeout shape and is in the fence to edit; a third file would be one more place to keep in sync for six lines of logic. The two callers' FALLBACKS differ on purpose (Dictate falls back to the dev-server rpc:append file log; compose falls back to the old one-shot assistant stream), so only the POST attempt itself is shared, not the whole log_prompt method.
